## What changes and why

Describe the coherent update and its impact. Link the related topic/open proposal; explain whether this updates an existing home, adds a justified topic, retains evidence only, or addresses a gap.

## Evidence and limits

Link original evidence/provenance or documented verification. Preserve relevant dates, versions, audience, exceptions, and unresolved questions. Distinguish accepted decisions from observed capabilities and plans.

## Validation and review

Report the three objective check results and relevant advisory findings. Identify the eligible independent human reviewer. Auto-merge must be enabled per PR and waits for valid approval and checks; changes to files invalidate approval.

## Maintenance only

Delete this section for ordinary information updates. For instructions, checks, workflows, approvers, or starter upgrades, record:

- Owner requester and request context:
- Authorized scope:
- Behavioral changes and preserved local adaptations:
- Starter origin and exact changes adopted or omitted:
- GitHub settings requiring separately authorized application and effective verification:

The existing reviewer verifies the request and scope under currently effective rules. Proposed rules cannot authorize their own adoption.
